# ShieldMeBruh

> ShieldMeBruh is automatically equips a selected shield when a one-handed weapon is equipped. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Equipment state monitoring and automatic shield equip selection**: Equipment state monitoring and automatic shield equip selection.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal equipment watchers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal equipment watchers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/ShieldMeBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
